question.question: Scientific decision for Camellia sinensis — green tea extract providing 900 mg EGCG per daily portion in an EU food supplement
question.indication: green tea extract providing 900 mg EGCG per daily portion in an EU food supplement

records.notes: EU rules require green tea extract foods to contain less than 800 mg EGCG per daily portion; the proposed daily portion provides 900 mg.
